theme_central: A cascade of cosmic oaths to introduce the soul itself: whoever purifies it succeeds, whoever corrupts it fails — illustrated by Thamud, who killed the she-camel out of excess.

branches.title: Cosmic oaths
branches.resume: Oaths by the sun, the moon, the day, the night, the sky and the earth.

children.t: Oaths by the sun, the moon, the sky and the earth

branches.title: The soul, purification or corruption
branches.resume: The soul harmoniously formed, inspired with immorality and piety; success through purification, failure through corruption.

children.t: Success through purifying the soul, failure through corrupting it

branches.title: Thamud, the she-camel
branches.resume: Thamud denied out of excess, killed the she-camel despite the Messenger's warning; destruction for that sin.

children.t: Thamud kills the she-camel out of excess, destroyed for that sin
